title: Palestinian Girl Shot by Israeli Forces; Israel Imposes Week-Long West Bank Closure
detail: Israeli forces shot a Palestinian girl in the occupied West Bank. Israel simultaneously imposed a week-long closure of the West Bank and all border crossings, coinciding with the Jewish holiday period, severely restricting Palestinian movement and commerce.

title: Israeli Finance Minister Smotrich Calls for 'Gaza-Style War' in Occupied West Bank
detail: Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich publicly called for a 'Gaza-style war' in the occupied West Bank, escalating far-right pressure on the Israeli government to intensify military operations across the territory and signaling potential expansion of large-scale military offensives beyond Gaza.

media.caption: Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich calls for Gaza-style war in West Bank

title: Israeli Bulldozers Demolish Odeh Family Home in West Bank in 20 Minutes
detail: Israeli bulldozers demolished the Odeh family's home in the occupied West Bank in approximately 20 minutes, illustrating the accelerating pace of settler-related displacement and home demolitions across the territory. The incident was documented in detail, highlighting the speed and scale of forced displacement operations.

title: Israeli Security Forces Conduct Home Check on Palestinian-American After Settler Violence
detail: Israeli security forces conducted a home check on a Palestinian-American resident in the occupied West Bank following reports of settler violence against the individual, according to Yahoo News. The incident highlights the intersection of settler attacks and Israeli military responses in the West Bank.

title: Israeli Settlers Damage Homes, Cut Water and Electricity in Palestinian Community Near Ramallah
detail: Israeli settlers damaged homes and severed water and electricity connections in a Palestinian community near Ramallah in the occupied West Bank, according to Arab News. The attack on utilities compounded the physical destruction of property, cutting off essential services to the affected residents.
